a.xlink:title: Displays the enlarged version of the card's pixmap near the cursor.
Sets the pixmap for the widget based on a provided card.
Marks the pixmap as dirty and triggers a widget repaint.
Loads the pixmap based on the given size and card information.
Emitted when a pixmap for this card has been updated or finished loading.
Retrieve a generic card back pixmap.
Retrieve a card pixmap, either from cache or enqueued for loading.
